# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ddos_prevention

Configures DDoS prevention for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/ddos_prevention`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ddos_prevention` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ddos_prevention" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status             = true
    action             = "block_period"
    challenge          = "real-browser-enforcement"
    http_access_limit  = true
    http_request_limit = 1000
    conn_flood_check   = true
    conn_flood_limit   = 100
    http_flood_prevent = true
    http_session_limit = 500
    tcp_flood_prevent  = false
    tcp_conn_num_limit = 255
    block_period       = 600

    ip_exception {
      item {
        ip = "1.1.1.1-1.1.1.2,1.1.1.4"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed DDoS prevention configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_ddos_prevention` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ddos_prevention.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
